pages.text: The Queen of Blades, in the head of the leviathan high in the stratosphere over the zerg lair.

Leaping strike and psionic shift; she dodges shots, comes at you from the side and falls back when badly hurt. At 2/3 health she calls mutalisks and a corruptor; at 1/3 she rages and calls brood lords. Her bar shows the phase.$(br2)$(l)When beaten$() Amun's hold breaks and the hero joins you (see Amun's Hold), leaving: Kerrigan's Crown, the rest of a zerg suit, 16 chitin shards, 8 diamonds.
